Name: Item Locator
Author: MysticalAsian
Description:
[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
Item Locator is a mod that solves the issue of not being able to find an item lost in dozens of chests. After typing in the name of an item you're trying to locate within the Item Locator menu, simply click the magnifying glass saying "Locate Item" and it will draw the shortest path on your screen to all containers that contain the item you're looking for. It also holds the history of the past 5 items you have tried locating.

[size=5][b]Compatible Containers:[/b][/size]
There could be other containers that are supported that I do not know about, or containers that SHOULD be supported but are not.
[list]
[*][size=2]Chests/Big Chests[/size]
[*][size=2]Stone Chests/Big Stone Chests[/size]
[*][size=2]Small Fridges[/size]
[*][size=2]House Fridges (and on the ginger island farm house too)[/size]
[*][size=2]Junimo Chests[/size]
[*][size=2]Junimo Huts[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
You're able to change the keybind used to open up the Item Locator menu within config files, with added support of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu
[/url][b] ﻿By default the keybind to open the menu is O﻿[/b]
You're able to change the path transparency within config files, with added support of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[size=2] ﻿[b]By default, this value is 0.15
[/b]
[/size][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[/b]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6
